summary: Completed testing of auto-recalculation feature for PUT /api/inventory/ingredients/{id} (Iteration 159). All 12 backend tests passed (100%). The auto-recalc feature correctly triggers recipe cost recalculation when ingredient cost_per_unit or yield_waste_percent changes, while protecting OrderItem snapshots in proposals.
critical_code_review_comments: VERIFIED: PUT /api/inventory/ingredients/{id} with cost_per_unit change triggers auto-recalc on recipes using that ingredient
VERIFIED: PUT with yield_waste_percent change (no price change) also triggers auto-recalc
VERIFIED: PUT with non-cost changes (name, brand, sku) does NOT trigger auto-recalc (last_cost_recalc_at unchanged)
VERIFIED: OrderItems in proposals maintain their original unit_price and internal_cost after ingredient cost change (snapshot protection)
VERIFIED: Sub-recipe cascade works - child recipe using ingredient gets recalculated when ingredient changes
VERIFIED: Multiple recipes (3) using same ingredient all get recalculated with last_cost_recalc_at set
VERIFIED: PUT works normally when no recipes use the ingredient (no error)
VERIFIED: Recipe fields populated after recalc: total_cost, last_cost_recalc_at, last_cost_recalc_trigger='ingredient:{id}'
REGRESSION PASSED: Recipe CRUD, Production batches GET, Purchase orders GET, Proposals GET, Cost preview all working

context_for_next_testing_agent: Auto-recalc feature fully tested. Key implementation details: (1) update_ingredient detects cost_changed (cost_per_unit, cost_per_base_unit, purchase_cost) and waste_changed (yield_waste_percent), (2) _recalc_recipes_using_ingredient() finds recipes using ingredient via ingredients.item_id or ingredients.ingredient_id, (3) One level of sub-recipe cascade via sub_recipes.child_recipe_id, (4) OrderItems are NOT modified - they store internal_cost as static snapshot at creation time.
